title: Reintentar detalle PIN de Live en navegador angosto capaz
mission: Execute the published Live page in a controllable narrow JavaScript browser and verify expanded worker PIN detail, navigation and page overflow without changing product state.
definition_of_done: Run the published Live UI at a narrow viewport.
Expand a contended or recovered worker and verify compact generation, owner, collision and recovery evidence.
Confirm no page-wide horizontal overflow and readable text.
Confirm tabs/swipe and 6m/10m liveness behavior still work.
Record exact failures if present; do not infer Human Accepted.
